english.title: Holder of non-UK pilot's licence act as flight crew in / over UK other than in accordance with CAA permission
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a pilot's licence, endorsed to the effect that the holder did not satisfy in full the relevant minimum standards established under the Chicago Convention, and which had been granted or rendered valid under the Air Navigation Order 2016 , acted as a member of the flight crew of an aircraft in or over the United Kingdom other than in accordance with a permission granted by the CAA in that **(..SPECIFY BREACH..)
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 151(3) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
